item.title: Taxpayers in waist-deep water: Gurgaon's annual infrastructure betrayal
item.summary: Gurgaon experienced significant disruption from recent monsoon rains. Major roads flooded, causing extensive traffic jams and stranding many commuters. Despite substantial infrastructure spending, the city faces recurring waterlogging issues. Civic body vacancies and a focus on symptoms hinder long-term resilience efforts. Changing rainfall patterns necessitate updated urban planning for future preparedness.
